notes.title: End of Development and Removal from Steam
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]I want to inform you that this tool will [b]no longer be developed[/b] or updated. It started as a student project in Early Access, but over the years it has remained unfinished and will not move forward.[/p][p]Because of this, I have decided to retire the product from the Steam Store. This means it will no longer be available for purchase, and it will also no longer be visible to new customers.[/p][p]For those [b]who already own it: nothing changes[/b]. You will continue to have [b]full access[/b] and can keep using it just as before.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who supported the project.[/p]

notes.title: Beta Test
notes.notes:
Soon the first test run will start. All people that registered for playtesting will gain access at [b]13 september 2021 3:00 p.m. (GMT+2) [/b].
After that new playtesters will be able to register.

Please complete the [b]survey[/b] which you can find in discord or in the Voice Visualizer settings.
